thread:
cam_sales: FYI NimbusBank POC started today and their automated scanner is triggering lots of 401s (SSO) and 429s. Ramp sync at 11:30 ET. Need SE + infra + security in the loop. :rotating_light:
diego_se: Any sample errors or request patterns? Hosted or Dedicated?
cam_sales: Hosted trial sandbox. Errors seen: {"error":"invalid_token","hint":"token_revoked"} and {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":1.2}. They ran a credentials-based scan that spiked to ~800 reqs/min for a short window.
anya_prod: That explains the 401s — looks like the scanner hits the OIDC provider and some tokens are getting revoked. Could be concurrency + clock skew. Do we have ingress logs?
infra_oncall: Pulling logs now. I see repeated POSTs from their IP block 18.45.2.0/24 with rapid retries. Our default per-key limit is 200/min. They're exceeding that by margin.
cam_sales: Customer also asked about pricing for Dedicated for their production timeline, and they sent a security questionnaire asking about KMS, retention, SOC2 artifacts. Ryan will need to follow on that.
ryan_csm: I got it. For pricing: we can propose a short Dedicated eval quote, or bump Hosted trial quotas for POC. I'll prepare a one-pager. For security Qs, I'll coordinate with security — what docs do they need first?
security_bot: New ticket created: SEC-4567. Requested docs: encryption in transit & at rest, KMS integrations, log retention policies, SOC2 scope. SLA requested as part of enterprise evaluation.
diego_se: Quick mitigations to keep the POC alive for the ramp: 1) issue short-lived service token for the scanner to avoid SSO token churn, 2) temporarily increase route burst/quota for the sandbox, 3) add client-side retry/backoff guidance. Sample route update: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood.run/api/v1/routes/update \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n -d '{"route":"nimbus-gen","policy":{"burst":400,"max_concurrency":50}}'```
infra_oncall: Applying route update now.
deploy-bot: route update applied: route "nimbus-gen" policy updated by infra_oncall. :white_check_mark:
infra_oncall: Also minted a short-lived service token `st-nimbus-poc` TTL=24h and DM'ed it to their SE.
cam_sales: Customer accepted the service token for the test (they confirm via private msg). Running another ramp now.
infra_oncall: Observing results: 429s dropped from ~120/min to ~10-15/min after policy change and service token. 401s gone when scanner used the service token.
anya_prod: Good. Security note: ephemeral service token is fine short-term, but we must not leave it in place without KMS/rotation controls.
security_bot: Starting security review for SEC-4567. We'll provide KMS integration doc and retention policy by EOD+2 business days. For immediate POC, we can sign interim NDA and provide sanitized logs.
ryan_csm: I'll prep the NDA and the pricing estimate. Also flagging potential POC credit if they hit infra instability during trial.
diego_se: Action items: 1) Add a POC rate-limit playbook snippet for sales (recommended defaults & how to request temporary quota), 2) Draft Dedicated trial pricing sheet, 3) Follow up on SEC-4567 and attach artifacts to support ticket SUP-9002. ETA: EOD.
cam_sales: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until SEC-4567 has initial docs and pricing one-pager is shared. Please post final notes and any permanent config changes. :thumbsup:
